source_A.finding: Four declared joint families: J_RAIL, J_SEATBACK, J_LINK_L, J_LINK_R; executable_joint_graph=false; DOF and limits are metadata only.

source_B.finding: Six MODEL_SPECIFICATION_ONLY records: two physical rail-to-carriage prismatic records, one seatback revolute record, two model-defined linkage records, and one state-dependent LOCK170 constraint.

The recorded 32 claim is contradicted by its named SR11 source and scaffold; 16 is a V7 reference/BOM count; 31 is a historical logical/body-group count; 21 and 62 are B-Rep solid counts at other geometry grains. None establishes a current physical rigid-body count. Duplicate/reference/visual/construction-body inclusion is not released.
evidence: SR11 mapping has 31 entries and declares deterministic 62-solid coverage.
V7 verifier distinguishes 16 BOM records from 21 reconstruction solids.
conflicts.resolution_status: 32 count claim REJECTED as unsupported by its cited artifact; canonical physical body set remains BLOCKED.
